design_directions.name: Swiss Modernist Studio

scale.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-[1.08]
scale.section_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-snug

spacing_and_layout.generous_padding_philosophy: Containers with borders must use p-6 or p-8 minimum to prevent content text collision. Section margins should be py-16 to py-24 for luxurious breathing room.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Grid containers use gap-6 or gap-8. Hero items span col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2. Supporting visual cards span col-span-4.

component_styles.Button: Pill or sharp rounded-full/rounded-md, high contrast hover transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2. Primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90. Secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80. Accent VTO CTA: bg-amber-500 text-black font-semibold hover:bg-amber-400.
component_styles.Card: Flat surface with 1px border (border-border), rounded-xl, shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300 bg-card text-card-foreground overflow-hidden
component_styles.Input: rounded-lg border-input bg-background/50 backdrop-blur-sm px-4 py-2.5 text-sm ring-offset-background placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring
component_styles.Dialog: Glassmorphism backdrop (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 dark:bg-black/80), dialog content bg-card border border-border/80 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-6 sm:p-8 max-w-lg w-full
component_styles.Tabs: TabList: bg-muted p-1 rounded-full flex gap-1 h-auto. TabTrigger: rounded-full px-5 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-all data-[state=active]:bg-background data-[state=active]:text-foreground data-[state=active]:shadow-sm
component_styles.Table: Dense luxury layout, border-collapse, header with text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground border-b border-border bg-muted/40, rows hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors
component_styles.Badge: rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium border border-border/60 bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5 w-fit
component_styles.Toast: Sonner toast popup with glassmorphic backdrop, crisp borders, and dark/light color match. Position top-right or bottom-right.
component_styles.Dropdown: DO NOT use transparent background! MUST use bg-popover text-popover-foreground border border-border rounded-xl shadow-xl p-1 z-50 min-w-[10rem]

landing.hero: Split editorial banner with high-fashion model backdrop, glassmorphic floating VTO feature teaser badge, bold heading 'The Atelier of Intelligent Style', primary CTA 'Experience AI Virtual Try-On' + secondary CTA 'Explore Catalog'
landing.features: Bento Grid displaying: 1. AI Body Estimation (Photo/Camera), 2. Outfit Canvas Builder, 3. External Shopping Links (Lazada/Shopee PH), 4. Personal Wardrobe Storage
landing.ph_brands_showcase: Partner brand carousel/grid featuring Philippine fashion & retail links (Zalora PH, Bench, Kultura, Shopee, Lazada) with clear external shop badge
landing.vto_demo_teaser: Interactive preview box showcasing simulated garment draping before and after

catalog.filters: Sticky sidebar or top filter bar: Categories (Tops, Bottoms, Dresses, Jackets, Jewelry, Accessories, Shoes), Price range, Style Tags (Minimalist, Formal, Casual, Streetwear, Filipiniana), Search bar
catalog.product_grid: 3 to 4 column responsive grid of luxury fashion cards with hover zoom on model/clothing photos, bookmark/wardrobe button, quick try-on action button

product_detail.layout: Two-column split view (Left: High-res image gallery with thumbnails & zoom. Right: Product Title, Brand, Category, Style Tags, Price, PH Partner Buy Links, 'Try On This Item' direct action button, Fabric/Care details)

try_on_viewer.layout: Interactive Studio Workspace. Split View: Left pane for User Photo/Camera upload + Body Info preset selector; Right pane for AI Render Canvas.
try_on_viewer.placeholder_notice: CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: Must feature a prominent notice banner 'DEVELOPMENT / INTEGRATION PLACEHOLDER — AI Engine Adapter in Mock Mode' with simulated rendering progress loader, keypoints overlay toggle, and confidence score widget.

outfit_builder.layout: Canvas Drag/Select Workspace. Slots for: Top, Bottom, Dress, Jacket, Jewelry, Accessories, Shoes. Quick wardrobe selector sidebar, total outfit price calculation, 'Save Outfit to Wardrobe' button, and 'Try-On Complete Outfit' trigger.

wardrobe.layout: Tabbed management hub: 1. Saved Items, 2. Created Outfits, 3. Saved Try-On Render History. Grid items include share, delete, buy external link, and re-try-on actions.

profile.layout: User Profile & Body Info Settings. Avatar, Name, Email, Height, Weight, Chest/Waist/Hips measurements, Preferred Fit (Tailored, Loose, Oversized), Auth JWT session info card.

login_signup.layout: Minimalist centered glassmorphic card with tab toggle for Login / Sign Up, email/password fields, remember me, simulated JWT token response feedback.

admin_dashboard.layout: Desktop-first Admin Portal. Left collapsible sidebar (Overview, Product Catalog, Wardrobe Analytics, User Audits, System Import). Header with theme toggle, search, notification bell, admin profile avatar.
components: KPI Stat Cards (Total Products, Active Try-On Sessions, External Click-throughs, System Latency)
Data Tables for Product Inventory management (with edit, delete, add modal)
JSON/CSV Bulk Import Controls for fashion catalog
Analytics Charts (Try-on activity over time, top try-on categories)
Audit Logs table with timestamp, user ID, action type, status

instructions_to_main_agent.testing_attribute_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='try-on-submit-button', data-testid='admin-product-table', data-testid='theme-toggle-button', data-testid='virtual-tryon-placeholder-badge').
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_persistence: Dark/Light theme state MUST persist in localStorage and sync with the HTML class list ('dark' or 'light').
instructions_to_main_agent.mock_vto_notice: In the Virtual Try-On section, explicitly include the 'Development / Integration Placeholder' badge and status banner so users and reviewers know it is a simulated/adapter AI engine for research/thesis purposes.
instructions_to_main_agent.shopping_redirects: Ensure shopping links (Lazada, Shopee, PH local brands) open in a new tab with rel='noopener noreferrer' and do not trigger internal checkout flows.
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_js_note: Project files are .js/.jsx, so do not output TypeScript syntax inside JS files.
